clue.text: Service decoration is testament to Antwerp muddle

parts.note: a will is a last testament

indicators.note: a muddle is a confused jumble, so the preceding words are to be scrambled

explanation.surface: A confused Belgian city seems to bear witness to some ornamental design, perhaps for a military service medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' is a dinner service, a set of china, not an armed service; the willow pattern is the classic blue-and-white design on such plates.
explanation.definitionFit: The blue-and-white Chinese landscape motif is the most famous design printed on plates and cups of a dinner set.

clue.text: I'm immaculate, but flawed

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of being spotless while admitting faults in the same breath.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawed has defects and falls short of being complete or faultless, the grammatical tense name aside.

clue.text: Traditions surrounding one French river

indicators.note: surrounding tells us the first word's letters go around the next piece

parts.note: lore is a body of traditional knowledge

explanation.surface: Local customs gather around a single river in France.
explanation.definitionFit: The longest river in France, flowing west past Orléans and Tours to the Atlantic, famous for its châteaux.

clue.text: Grain produced with heat

parts.note: W is a standard abbreviation for with

explanation.surface: A cereal crop is ripened by warmth, or perhaps baked in an oven.
explanation.definitionFit: A cereal crop whose seeds are milled to make flour for bread is the standard example of grain.

clue.text: Vivacity may turn into mania

indicators.note: turning one thing into another suggests the letters are rearranged into a new form

explanation.surface: High spirits can tip over into frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' looks like a link between turning and mania, but it is part of the letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Liveliness and spirited energy in manner or expression is a common sense of the word, as in speaking with great animation.

clue.text: Most sensitive care of broken trees

parts.note: to tend is to care for

indicators.note: something broken has its parts disordered, so the following word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tree surgeon treats damaged trunks with the greatest delicacy.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of tender, which can mean painful to touch or easily hurt, so the most delicate or sore.

clue.text: Stick up note I composed for teacher

indicators.note: composed in the sense of put together, signalling the pieces are joined in sequence
in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upward, so backwards

parts.note: a bar is a stick or rod

explanation.surface: Someone pins up a note they wrote for their teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: BAR reversed gives RAB; 'up' works for a reversal only because this is a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is Hebrew for 'my master', and a rabbi is a Jewish scholar and religious teacher.

clue.text: Perk is borderline advantage

parts.note: a fringe is an edge or border, used as an adjective

explanation.surface: A workplace perk is described as only marginally useful.
explanation.definitionFit: An extra given by an employer on top of salary, such as a company car, is exactly what a perk means.

clue.text: Old timers got a new specialist

indicators.note: making something new means remaking it, so the preceding letters are rebuilt in fresh order

explanation.surface: Elderly people were sent to see a fresh consultant.
explanation.walkthrough: The apt hint is that old timers are likely to have wrinkled skin, the domain of this specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor devoted to one branch of medicine, here the skin, is a medical specialist.

clue.text: Anger about unusual pet — a crocodile, perhaps

indicators.note: unusual suggests the following word is put in an unexpected order
about means going around, so the first word's letters wrap the rest

parts.note: the word pet with its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Fury over an odd household pet, namely a crocodile.
explanation.definitionFit: A crocodile is one example of a cold-blooded scaly animal, hence 'perhaps' marking the definition by example.

clue.text: Dishonourable soldier turning against aristocrat

indicators.note: turning round signals the soldier's letters are read backwards

explanation.surface: A disgraceful soldier turns on a member of the nobility.
explanation.walkthrough: 'against' here means next to, so the two pieces sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignoble means base and lacking honour or principle, the opposite of noble in character.

clue.text: Bravery is never wavering

indicators.note: wavering means unsteady and shifting about, so the word's letters move into a new order

explanation.surface: A neat definition of courage: never hesitating.
explanation.definitionFit: Courage and steadiness in the face of danger, as in having the nerve to do something, is a common synonym.

clue.text: Bend a prize mutt almost into shape

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter of the dog word is dropped
to bend is to twist out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the dog word without its final letter

explanation.surface: An instruction to contort a champion mongrel into a geometric figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-sided figure with one pair of parallel sides in British usage, so a geometric shape.

clue.text: Pick the best

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to choose, especially by vote
second meaning: the chosen few, an elite group

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as an instruction to choose the finest; the second meaning is the noun, as in 'God's elect'.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to choose by voting; as a plural noun it means those specially chosen, the elite.

clue.text: Blurt tune out, causing disturbance

indicators.note: out in the sense of disordered or awry, so the preceding letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone loudly bursts into song and upsets those nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Turbulent means unruly and agitated, stirring up unrest or commotion, as in a turbulent crowd.

clue.text: Fish for a little and then be back to island

parts.note: a whit is a tiny amount

indicators.note: going back means the two-letter word is read from right to left

parts.note: an ait is a small river island, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: Advice to go fishing a while, then return to an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny young herring and sprats, eaten whole after frying, are sold under this collective name for small fish.

clue.text: Richer, because we all nearly have their mixture

indicators.note: nearly means not quite complete, so the word before it loses its last letter
a mixture blends things together, so all these letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: the word minus its final letter

explanation.surface: Someone explains they are better off because everyone shares in a family recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Having greater wealth means having more money and assets, which is simply being richer.

clue.text: If I remix middle of sample first, it increases volume

indicators.note: first says which piece goes at the front when the parts are joined
the middle of a word means its outer letters are discarded and the centre kept

parts.note: the word with its first and last letters removed

indicators.note: read as re-mix: the mix part tells us the letters before it, with the re prefix, are blended into a new order

parts.note: the first two letters of the word remix, split off as fodder

explanation.surface: A DJ describes reworking a sample to boost the sound level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remix' is split as re-mix: RE joins the fodder and 'mix' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An electronic device that boosts a signal so speakers play louder is the standard kit for making things louder.

clue.text: Please consider

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to amuse or delight
second meaning: to hold in mind, as an idea or offer

explanation.walkthrough: 'Please' reads as a polite request; it is the verb meaning to delight.
explanation.definitionFit: To amuse guests is to delight them, and to entertain an idea is to give it thought or take it seriously.

clue.text: 24 actor spotted during visit to Poland

indicators.note: spotted during says the name is seen inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the last three words

explanation.surface: A performer was seen while on a trip to Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 refers to the answer at 24-across, ISRAELI.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaim Topol was the Israeli actor famous for playing Tevye in Fiddler on the Roof.

clue.text: Thickly spread piece of bread found in terrible need

indicators.note: found in means the first piece sits inside the second
terrible suggests something gone badly wrong, so the following word's letters are scrambled

parts.note: a crust is the hard outer piece of a loaf
the word need with its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone desperately hungry finds a thickly buttered slice.
explanation.definitionFit: Covered with a hard coating or a dense layer, as with jewels or dirt, is what encrusted means.

clue.text: Some find magic or fun on a Greek island

indicators.note: some means a portion of the words that follow, so the answer is a part of them

parts.note: the letters run from the end of the first word into the last

explanation.surface: Holidaymakers enjoy enchantment or amusement on a Greek holiday isle.
explanation.definitionFit: An island in the Ionian Sea off north-west Greece, popular with tourists and once home to the Durrell family.

clue.text: Fine food shop reportedly found in India

definitions.note: the answer is a place that is found in India

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so we want a word sounding like the shop

explanation.surface: A gourmet store said to exist in India.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the answer is the city found in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is the capital territory of India, containing New Delhi, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: Sharp pain inflicted by ex-policeman?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a prickling hurt, as from a wasp
second meaning: a former member of the rock band The Police

explanation.walkthrough: 'ex-policeman' suggests a retired officer, but it is a former band member: the singer of The Police went solo under this name. The question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasp or nettle causes a sudden smarting hurt, and the Police frontman took this as his stage name.

clue.text: Shoot southern puritan

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for south or southern
a prig is a self-righteously proper person

explanation.surface: An order to gun down a strait-laced person from the south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' looks like a verb; it is the noun for a young growth on a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A small stem or twig cut from a plant, like a sprig of parsley, is a young shoot.

clue.text: Is the artist a prophet, one from the Middle East?

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, the crossword artist
Eli is the Old Testament priest who taught Samuel

explanation.surface: A question whether a painter is also a seer from the Levant.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of the Jewish state on the eastern Mediterranean is a person from that region.

clue.text: Trucks emerge from Rolls-Royce with oil mixture over bearings

indicators.note: a mixture stirs things together, so the gathered letters are jumbled

parts.note: RR is the abbreviation for the car maker

explanation.surface: Heavy goods vehicles roll out of a luxury carmaker's plant, oiled and with greased bearings.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorry is the British word for a truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorry is the standard British term for a large goods vehicle, which Americans call a truck.

clue.text: One can't catch ferrets with big nut trick

indicators.note: a trick deceives by sleight of hand, so these letters are shifted around

explanation.surface: Someone fails to trap ferrets, even with a large nut as bait.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy person who keeps dropping things, especially a fielder dropping a ball, is called this informally.
